name: Spy Grid
tagline: One-word clues. Find your agents. Avoid the trap.
description: Two teams, one grid of 25 words. Only the spymasters know which words are their agents. Give a one-word clue and a number, point together to flip the cards, and never touch the assassin. With 2–3 players it's a co-op mission.
howToPlay: Two teams, 25 words. Only each spymaster knows which words are their agents.
Your spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number. Point together at the words that fit.
Find all your agents first. Touch the assassin and your team loses on the spot.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Two teams, or one team on a co-op mission (auto: co-op at 2–3 players)

settings.label: Teams
settings.description: Players pick their team and spymaster, or the game deals them

settings.label: Rounds
settings.description: A new board each round; spymasters rotate

settings.label: Clue time
settings.description: Seconds the spymaster has to give a clue

settings.label: Guess time
settings.description: Seconds per guess; the clock restarts after every flip

settings.label: Turn limit
settings.description: Turns per round (both teams); then fewer agents left wins

settings.label: Co-op clues
settings.description: Clues the co-op team gets to find all nine agents

settings.label: Assassins
settings.description: A second assassin replaces a bystander

settings.label: Reactions
settings.description: 👍 👎 🤔 on cards, for teams that can't talk

settings.label: Spicy words
settings.description: Mixes in adult words (hangovers, dating, office life) — never explicit

settings.label: Reader
settings.description: The voice that reads each clue aloud
